description.en: An open registry of DeepSeek Harness plugins. Currently includes Agent Plugin Hub, which hosts Claude Code, CodeBuddy and ZCode agent plugins as native DSH skills, commands, hooks and MCP servers.
description.zh-cn: DeepSeek Harness 插件源，目前收录智能体插件中心（Agent Plugin Hub）：在 DSH 内托管 Claude Code、CodeBuddy、ZCode 等智能体插件，并将其能力映射为 DSH 技能、命令、hooks 与 MCP。
